answer.rationale: The 24-hour reporting obligation under §1904.39(a)(2) applies only to in-patient hospitalizations that result from a work-related incident. The scenario does not establish that the illness was work-related or confirm that the hospitalization was for in-patient treatment, both of which are material predicates for determining whether the 24-hour reporting duty is triggered.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Need confirmation of (1) whether the illness is determined to be work-related per §1904.5 work-relatedness criteria, and (2) whether the hospital admission constituted formal in-patient hospitalization for treatment (as opposed to observation/testing only).
